exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Do you like the neighbourhood you live in? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: What do you do in your neighbourhood in your free time? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: What new things would you like to have in your neighbourhood? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Would you like to live in another neighbourhood in your town or city? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a website you have bought something from. You should say: what the website is what you bought from this website how satisfied you were with what you bought and explain what you liked and disliked about using this website.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What kinds of things do people in your country often buy from online shops?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why has online shopping become so popular in many countries?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: What are some possible disadvantages of buying things from online shops?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that the prices of all goods should be lower on internet shopping sites than in shops?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Will large shopping malls continue to be popular, despite the growth of internet shopping?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you think that some businesses (e.g. banks and travel agents) will only operate online in the future?
